$comment: The approved-provider record for T0.1's network scripts. PROOF_STANDARD.md Version 3 §11
requires a two-provider claim to use providers with DIFFERENT OPERATORS, and requires that
independence to be checked against a machine-readable record rather than asserted in prose.
URLs are NOT stored here. A provider's URL is supplied by the environment variable named in
'urlEnv' so that a key-bearing endpoint is never committed. Each run records the sanitized
canonical host it actually resolved to and refuses to proceed if that host is not the one this
record approves for that provider id.
'operator' must be a real, checkable operator identity. 'unknown' is honest and is exactly why
a pair containing it yields proofLevel 'one-domain' rather than 'two-distinct-operators'.

2026-09-23: operators for the two public endpoints corrected from 'unknown' to QuickNode and Monad Foundation, sourced from Monad's own documentation. They were never unknowable; nobody had looked. Any pair drawn from {QuickNode, Monad Foundation, Alchemy} is two distinct operators. QuickNode's own service and testnet-rpc.monad.xyz are the SAME operator and must never be paired.

providers.operatorEvidence: Monad's own testnet documentation names QuickNode as the provider for this endpoint, with archive supported: https://docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/testnet (read 2026-09-23). This endpoint is therefore NOT independent of a QuickNode account, and the two must never be counted as a pair.
providers.archiveSupport: Documented by Monad as archive-supported; measured deterministic to 43.6 days (8/8), refused at 50.8 days (0/8), 2026-09-22
providers.finalizedTag: supported, lag 3 to 4 blocks / 1 second measured 2026-09-22
providers.notes: Recorded as operator 'unknown' until 2026-09-23. That was an omission, not a limit of what is knowable: Monad publishes the operator. Correcting it turned an existing byte-identical agreement into a genuine two-operator pair.
providers.rateLimits: 50 rps, 25 rps for eth_call and eth_estimateGas; batch 100

providers.operatorEvidence: Monad's own testnet documentation names Monad Foundation as the provider for this endpoint, with archive supported: https://docs.monad.xyz/developer-essentials/testnet (read 2026-09-23). 'Monad Infra' is not a separate company; it is a Foundation property.
providers.archiveSupport: INTERMITTENT: measured 5/8, 6/8 and 1/8 at three historical blocks, 2026-09-22. Load balancer over backends with unequal pruning.
providers.finalizedTag: supported, lag 3 to 4 blocks / 1 second measured 2026-09-22
providers.notes: Agrees byte for byte with the QuickNode endpoint when it answers, including on the mandatory fixture at block 62922075. Measured INTERMITTENT at deeper blocks (5/8, 6/8, 1/8 at 23, 43.6 and 50.8 days, 2026-09-22), so a not-served answer here is ARCHIVE_UNAVAILABLE, never a verification failure. No key and no account required.

providers.operatorEvidence: a named company with its own account, quota and billing relationship; the only provider in this project with an established distinct operator
providers.archiveSupport: CONFIRMED 2026-09-23: served eth_call at block 62922075, 7 days old, byte-identical to the QuickNode endpoint. The 2026-09-21 'monthly capacity exceeded' 429 has cleared.
providers.failureDomain: distinct from the public endpoints: separate company, separate account, separate quota
providers.notes: Confirmed working 2026-09-23 with Joshua's key on the 'mako markets' app. Requires MAKO_RPC_ALCHEMY to carry the full https:// endpoint. Ticket #23824 for the 2026-09-21 429 is likely closable.

providers.archiveSupport: UNUSABLE: eth_getBlockByNumber unavailable at historical blocks, and eth_call refused with 'user-specified gas exceeds provider limit', measured 2026-09-22 and again 2026-09-23
providers.notes: Recorded so it is not retried by a later reader. Free tier cannot serve this workload.

pairPolicy.twoDistinctOperators: Both providers must have a non-null 'operator' that is not 'unknown', and the two operators must differ. Only then may evidence carry proofLevel 'two-distinct-operators'.
pairPolicy.oneDomain: Any other pair. Evidence carries proofLevel 'one-domain', which PROOF_STANDARD.md Version 3 §1b states does not satisfy that section. A run invoked as proof exits non-zero with NOT_INDEPENDENT.
pairPolicy.hostCheck: The resolved host of each provider's URL must equal the 'host' recorded here for that id, or the run fails. This keeps a key out of the repository while making a swapped endpoint visible to a reviewer.
